Regarding this race.
Pour your whole heart and soul into identifying areas for my improvement.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"This humiliation
cannot be avenged without victory."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I will overwhelm them. I will surpass every single Umamusume and carve my victory into history.

text_block_list.text: That is the very proof of a "King."

text_block_list.text:
Of course.
...What kind of king would I be if I did not hold my pride high?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The one who reigns supreme over the world of racing
is none other than I, Orfevre.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"That is the ultimate truth of this world...
If so, I have only to prove it."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...Work hard.
So that I may take the throne."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The only one who reigns as King
is me, Orfevre.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I shall let you gaze upon my majesty to your heart's content...!
